notes: Compatibility bridge for schema 097. Promote and accept while schema 096 is serving; existing catalog, variants, guest checkout, delivery, and order operations remain available. Loyalty settings and verified-customer rewards fail closed or remain absent until this bridge is known-good and the separately locked automation creates and verifies a schema-096 backup, applies pinned expand migration 097, and revalidates the active release. Loyalty identity and discounts are enabled only with the schema-097 atomic functions. The retained schema-096 release remains a traffic rollback target only until migration begins; after schema advances to 097, forward repair is required by policy.
